+def rgb_to_lab(rgb: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

+    srgb = np.asarray(rgb, dtype=np.float64) / 255.0

+    rgb_to_xyz = np.array(
+        [[0.4124564, 0.3575761, 0.1804375],

+    )

+def target_palette_plan():
+    # Ten source samples per cell side retain color edges while keeping the
+    # planning grid aligned to an exact 26 x 26 partition.

+        Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB").resize((N * 10, N * 10), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS),
+        dtype=np.uint8,

+class Streamer:

+    def __init__(self, robot: Robot, current: np.ndarray):

+def make_run_order(paths: list[np.ndarray], current: np.ndarray) -> list[tuple[np.ndarray, bool]]:

+    remaining = list(paths)
+    out = []

+                # keeping it compact relative to the 8.7 mm cell spacing.
+                stream.append(np.array([start[0], start[1] - 0.003, COARSE_Z]))
+            else:
+                for p in points[1:]:
+                    stream.append(np.array([p[0], p[1], COARSE_Z]))
+            end = stream.current[:2].copy()
+            stream.line_to(np.array([end[0], end[1], TRANSIT_Z]), max_step=0.04)
+            stream.intended_strokes += 1
+        stream.progress("coarse", paint, len(runs[paint]), len(runs[paint]))
+
+    # Add the secondary colour in the most mixed cells using a lighter press.
+    for paint in range(16):
+        well_x, well_y = WELL_COORDS[paint]
+        stream.at_xy(np.array([well_x, well_y]), TRANSIT_Z)
+        stream.line_to(np.array([well_x, well_y, DIP_Z]), max_step=0.04)
+        stream.append(np.array([well_x, well_y, DIP_Z]))
+        stream.line_to(np.array([well_x, well_y, TRANSIT_Z]), max_step=0.04)
+
+        points = details[paint]
+        remaining = list(points)
+        while remaining:
+            pos = stream.current[:2]
+            idx = int(np.argmin([np.linalg.norm(pos - p) for p in remaining]))
+            p = remaining.pop(idx)
+            stream.at_xy(p, TRANSIT_Z)
+            contact = np.array([p[0], p[1], DETAIL_Z])
+            stream.line_to(contact, max_step=0.04)
+            stream.append(contact)
+            stream.append(np.array([p[0], p[1] - 0.0025, DETAIL_Z]))
+            stream.line_to(np.array([p[0], p[1] - 0.0025, TRANSIT_Z]), max_step=0.04)
+            stream.intended_strokes += 1
+        stream.progress("details", paint, len(details[paint]), len(details[paint]))
+
+    # Park outside the scored sheet and leave a clear final canvas frame.
+    stream.at_xy(np.array([0.0, -0.20]), TRANSIT_Z)
+    stream.line_to(np.array([0.0, -0.20, 0.28]), max_step=0.04)
+    stream.flush()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam", "scene_cam"], video="none")
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"final_{cam}.png")
+    status = robot.status()
+    final = {
+        "status": status,
+        "intended_main_strokes": stream.intended_strokes,
+        "reserved_prior_main_stroke": 1,
+        "planned_total_main_strokes": stream.intended_strokes + 1,
+        "action_rows": stream.sent_rows,
+        "flushes": stream.flushes,
+        "slow_rows": stream.slowed_rows,
+        "ik_failures": stream.ik_failures,
+        "wall_s_in_client": time.time() - stream.started,
+    }
+    (OUT / "gen_result.json").write_text(json.dumps(final, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(final, indent=2), flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
